name: input-group
title: Input Group
description: Input or textarea with pixel addons and buttons inside one sunken field.

typewriter.key.note: Typebar strike: sharp metal clack, then the platen thud just after

typewriter.space.note: Stabilized space bar: deeper plate ring and thock, with a faint stabilizer rattle

typewriter.return.note: Carriage return: lever clunk, then the end-of-line bell
